subject: [PATCH v4 07/11] mm, swap: reclaim physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch reclaims physical slots backing cache-only vswap entries when the swap is more than half used. Cache-only vswap entries are those where the vswap entry's swap_count has dropped to 0, but its folio is still in the swap cache. The patch introduces a new flag, SWP_RMAP_CACHE_ONLY, to mark such entries and allows reclaiming their physical slots from the physical reclaim scanner. This change aims to free up physical capacity for new allocations when the swap usage exceeds half of the available space.
